A '''flechette pistol''' was a pistol sized [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]]. Packing the destructive power of larger flechette launchers into the compact form of a pistol, a flechette pistol fired [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] filled miniature canisters or cartridges at impressive speeds. These would then airburst into a starlike pattern, releasing hundreds of tiny razor sharp blades into the air at lethal speeds.<ref name="Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] chose the flechette pistol as his primary weapon in an attempt to assassinate [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Due to the sheer number of projectiles released, he saw the flechette pistol as an ideal weapon for killing a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]; though the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] speed and Force senses allowed him to avoid the worst of the flechette bursts.<ref name="Pursuit" />
